en-US.description: Hardware verification tool for new or second-hand laptops
en-US.longDescription:
A hardware verification tool for newly purchased or second-hand PCs: one-click collection of CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, network adapter, display (including estimated color gamut), and battery information for manual cross-checking against order specifications. Mark as passed once verified (the dot on the left navigation turns green).
All hardware data collection is based on open-source components and native Windows APIs, completely free of closed-source commercial software.

Features

- Spec Verification: Automatically collects info in the background upon entering the page (smooth UI without freezing, with staged progress indicators), displayed in grouped cards. Click "Verified and Pass" after checking:
  - CPU: Model, core/thread count
  - GPU: Model, VRAM (read directly via NVAPI/ADL or registry qwMemorySize to avoid WMI >4 GB overflow issues), driver version
  - RAM: Total capacity, actual running frequency (current BIOS configured value); detailed per-stick info (slot/rated and actual frequency/manufacturer/part number) collapsed under "Details"
  - Storage: Capacity, drive letter(s) (C:/D:, etc.; multiple drive letters on a single disk are listed side by side), model, health status, power-on hours (read directly from SMART, requires administrator privileges; displays "Unknown" if unreadable)
  - Network Adapter: Model (all physical network adapters, consistent with Device Manager)
  - Display: Resolution, refresh rate, size (diagonal inches), panel name, color gamut — estimated sRGB / DCI-P3 volume ratio derived from EDID chromaticity coordinates (panel gamut points may exceed the standard gamut, so values can be >100%; represents volume ratio, not coverage)
  - Battery: Design capacity, full charge capacity, wear level (health), cycle count — using the same source as powercfg /batteryreport (battery class driver IOCTL / root\WMI battery class); unreadable items display "Unavailable", and non-battery devices display a prompt
- Keyboard Test: Full-size ANSI 104-key visual keyboard with real-time feedback on physical key presses (highlights on press, turns green on release), displays "Tested X / 104" progress, supports reset; keys not present on laptops (such as the numeric keypad) can simply be left gray
- Dead Pixel Test: Full-screen solid color inspection after selecting a monitor (White → Red → Green → Blue → Black). Switch colors with any key or mouse click, press Esc to exit; supports multi-monitor testing screen-by-screen to check for dead, bright, or dark pixels
- Audio & Video Test: Camera (device selection + real-time preview, automatically closes upon leaving the page), Microphone (real-time level meter animation + record/playback), Speaker (device selection + sample audio playback); one-click pass after verifying all three items
- Stress Test: Three modes available: CPU-only (prime95, compiled from GIMPS source for this project) / GPU-only (FurMark donut, reimplemented with C# / OpenTK) / CPU+GPU dual stress test; customizable FurMark resolution/fullscreen/anti-aliasing and prime95 thread count/FFT modes, with real-time elapsed time display; 4-channel real-time line charts for monitoring (CPU temp/power, GPU temp/power, polled every 2s via LibreHardwareMonitor; CPU monitoring requires the PawnIO kernel driver—a one-click silent installer with an official signature is provided on the page if not installed, ready to use immediately without rebooting); "Show UI" can be toggled off (stress test processes run entirely windowless in the background with identical load); execution log box records start/stop/crash events; multiple safety fallbacks on stop/tab switch/exit ensure no orphaned background stress test processes remain
- Disk Benchmark: Integrated CrystalDiskMark source (engine compiled as-is into a CdmHost console host + custom diskspd subprocess, completely windowless throughout), runs four tests on the target drive: SEQ1M Q8T1 sequential read/write + RND4K Q1T1 random read/write (1 GiB random data × 5 passes); result JSON and log CSV are saved in %APPDATA%\YanJi\disk_result (results folder can be opened directly from the page with one click)
- Dark/Light theme switching (follows system default), with the left navigation bar showing the completion status of each inspection item (green dot + ✓)
- Automatically navigates to the next uncompleted module upon clicking "Pass" in each module, with a completion prompt displayed in the navigation area once all are finished
- "Re-detect" in Spec Verification and "Reset" in Keyboard Test allow re-checks at any time (clears the passed status for a fresh verification)
- Modular Plugin Architecture: Every inspection module above is an independent plugin (located under plugins\ in the program directory); the installation wizard allows selective module installation; the "Plugin Management" menu in the top bar supports importing zip plugin packages (batch multi-selection supported since v0.0.2) and deleting plugins (loaded immediately upon import; deletion/overwriting completed automatically via restart), with component credits displayed per module (credits are tied to plugins and will disappear if the module is deleted). For plugin development, see AGENTS.md in the root directory

zh-CN.description: 二手/新机到手后的验机工具
zh-CN.longDescription:
二手/新机到手后的硬件配置核对工具：一键采集 CPU、显卡、内存、硬盘、网卡、屏幕（含色域估算）、电池信息， 人工与订单配置逐项核对，确认无误后标记通过（左侧导航圆点变绿）。
全部硬件采集基于开源组件与 Windows 自带接口，不含任何闭源商业软件。

功能

- 配置核对：进入页面即自动后台采集（不卡界面，有分阶段进度），分组卡片展示，核对后点「确认无误，通过」：
  - CPU：型号、核心/线程数
  - 显卡：型号、显存（NVAPI/ADL 或注册表 qwMemorySize 直读，避免 WMI 超过 4 GB 溢出的问题）、驱动版本
  - 内存：总容量、实际运行频率（BIOS 当前设定值）；每根详情（插槽/标称与实际频率/厂商/料号）折叠在「详细信息」中
  - 硬盘：容量、盘符（C:/D: 等，一块盘多个盘符会并列显示）、型号、健康度、通电时间（SMART 直读，需管理员权限；读不到时显示「未知」）
  - 网卡：型号（全部物理网卡，与设备管理器显示一致）
  - 屏幕：分辨率、刷新率、尺寸（对角线英寸）、面板名称、色域 —— 由 EDID 色度坐标估算的 sRGB / DCI-P3 容积比（面板顶点可超出标准色域，比值可能 >100%，是容积比而非覆盖率）
  - 电池：设计容量、完全充电容量、损耗（健康度）、循环次数 —— 与 powercfg /batteryreport 同源（电池类驱动 IOCTL / root\WMI 电池类）；读不到的项显示「无法读取」，无电池设备显示提示
- 键盘测试：全尺寸 ANSI 104 键可视化键盘，按物理键实时反馈（按住高亮、松开变绿）， 显示「已测试 X / 104」进度，可重置；笔记本没有的键（如小键盘）保持灰色即可
- 屏幕坏点：选显示器后全屏纯色检测（白→红→绿→蓝→黑），按任意键或单击鼠标切换、Esc 退出， 多屏逐台可测，检查坏点/亮点/暗点
- 影音会议：摄像头（设备可选 + 实时预览，离开页面自动关闭）、麦克风（电平条实时跳动 + 录制/回放）、 扬声器（设备可选 + 播放试音曲），三项确认后一键通过
- 散热测试：CPU 单烤（prime95，本项目按 GIMPS 源码编译）/ GPU 单烤（FurMark 毛球，C# / OpenTK 重实现） / 双烤三模式；FurMark 分辨率/全屏/抗锯齿与 prime95 线程数/FFT 模式可调，已烤时长实时显示； 数据监控四路实时折线（CPU 温度/功耗、GPU 温度/功耗，LibreHardwareMonitor 2 秒轮询； CPU 两路需要 PawnIO 内核驱动，未安装时页面可一键静默安装官方签名安装器，装后立即可用无需重启）；「显示界面」可关（烤机进程完全无窗口后台跑，负载不变）； 运行日志框记录起停/异常退出事件；停止/切页/退出多层兜底，不会留下后台烤机进程
- 硬盘跑分：CrystalDiskMark 源码集成（引擎原封编译为 CdmHost 控制台宿主 + 定制 diskspd 子进程，全程无窗口）， 对目标盘跑 SEQ1M Q8T1 顺序读/写 + RND4K Q1T1 随机读/写四项（1 GiB 随机数据 × 5 轮）； 成绩 JSON 与记录 CSV 保存在 %APPDATA%\YanJi\disk_result（页面上可一键打开成绩目录）
- 深/浅主题切换（默认跟随系统），左侧导航显示各验机项完成状态（绿点 + ✓）
- 每个模块点「确认通过」后自动跳转到下一个未完成模块，全部完成时导航区给出提示
- 配置核对「重新检测」、键盘测试「重置」可随时复查（会清除通过状态重新核对）
- 插件化：以上每个验机模块都是独立插件（程序目录 plugins\ 下）；安装向导可按模块勾选安装， 程序顶栏「插件管理」支持导入 zip 插件包（0.0.2 起可多选批量导入）/ 删除插件（导入即加载，删除/覆盖自动重启完成）， 并逐模块展示其组件致谢（致谢随插件走，删除模块其致谢也随之消失）。插件开发见根目录 AGENTS.md

zh-CN.releaseNotes:
- 配置核对硬盘部分新增「介质与数据完整性错误」一项（NVMe SMART，即 CrystalDiskInfo 的 0E 项）
- 验机关注值：正常应为 0 次，非 0 多为闪存/主控异常前兆（「0E 门」排查项）
- 仅 NVMe 盘显示数值（SATA 盘的同编号属性含义不同，不显示）；无权限/读不到时显示「未知」
